# Vendored browser dependencies

- Three.js 0.160.1: `three.module.js`, `OrbitControls.js`; MIT License.
- Lucide 0.468.0: `lucide.min.js`; ISC License.

The files are vendored so the local visualizer works without an internet connection.
Upstream URLs use the corresponding pinned packages from `cdn.jsdelivr.net`.
